On this shelf

Four corners of the house, one maker.

Cleaning

All-purpose, bathroom, glass and kitchen cleaners that rely on citric acid, thyme oil and coconut-derived cleansers.

Laundry

Super-concentrated detergent and stain remover. One small bottle handles dozens of loads.

Bath and body

Glycerin-rich body bars, washes, shampoo and toothpaste that clean without stripping your skin.

Essential oils

Pure single oils and blends, so your home smells good without synthetic air fresheners.

A clean home shouldn't come with a warning label.

Why people make the switch

Same weekly routine. A smarter shelf behind it.

01

Gentler on your home

Formulas built around naturally derived ingredients, like plant-based cleaners and essential oils. No chlorine bleach, no ammonia, no harsh fumes while you clean.

02

Cheaper per use

Concentrates mean you stop paying for water, oversized bottles and shelf space. One small bottle can replace several large ones, so each wash or clean costs less.

03

Straight from the maker

Ordered online direct from the manufacturer and delivered to your door. Fewer hands in the middle, and no queueing at the store.

04

A lighter footprint

Less water shipped around the country and less plastic for every use. Small per bottle, meaningful over a year of shopping.

Worth knowing

What are you really paying for?

Most ready-to-use cleaners are mainly water, shipped across the country in single-use plastic. A concentrate ships only the part that cleans. You add the water yourself, from your own tap.

  • ✓Less plastic. One small bottle refills the same spray bottle again and again.
  • ✓Less to ship and store. No paying to move water around, and more room under the sink.
  • ✓Lower cost per clean. The price looks similar on the shelf. Per use, it is not close.

Pay for what's in the bottle, not the hype around it.

The supplement aisle is crowded, confusing and often overpriced. A few simple checks can tell you whether what you take every day is well made, well absorbed and worth the money.

On this shelf

From your morning vitamins to your evening skin care.

Daily multivitamins

Complete vitamin and mineral packs for men and women, formulated so your body can actually absorb them.

Targeted nutrition

Omega-3, probiotics, calcium and more, to fill the specific gaps in your diet.

Fitness and nutrition

Protein shakes, bars and electrolyte drinks that are high in protein and fibre, and low in sugar.

Skin care and beauty

Cleansers, serums, moisturisers and hair care that pair proven actives with botanicals.

What you take every day deserves a second look.

Why people make the switch

Same daily habit. Better things in the bottle.

01

Made to be absorbed

A nutrient only helps if your body can take it in. The form an ingredient comes in matters as much as the number printed on the label.

02

From nature where it counts

Ingredients drawn from plants and whole foods where possible, without artificial colours, flavours or sweeteners padding out the tablet.

03

Better value per day

Buying direct from the maker removes layers of retail mark-up. Compare the cost of a daily serving, not the price on the box.

04

Evidence over endorsements

Look for a company that runs its own research and shares it openly, instead of leaning on famous faces and bold promises.

Worth knowing

How to read a supplement label in 30 seconds

The front of the box is marketing. The back is where the truth is. Here are the four places to look.

  • 1The MAL number and hologram. Health supplements sold in Malaysia must be registered with the Ministry of Health and carry both.
  • 2Servings per bottle. Price divided by servings gives you the cost per day, the only fair comparison.
  • 3The form in brackets. Vitamins and minerals come in many forms, and some are absorbed far better than others.
  • 4Other ingredients. This is where artificial colours, sweeteners and fillers hide.

Gentle on their skin. Gentle on your budget.

On this shelf

From the first bath to the school run.

Bath time

Tear-free baby shampoo and wash, made with plant-derived cleansers and botanicals like chamomile.

Skin and change time

Baby lotion with plant-derived moisturisers, and soft wipes for every change.

Growing kids

A gentle, concentrated detergent for the clothes and bedding that sit against their skin all day.

Everything that touches their skin matters.

Why people make the switch

Same bath-time routine. Kinder things in the bottle.

01

Mild by design

Washes and lotions built around plant-derived cleansers and moisturisers, made for delicate skin from the very first bath.

02

Tear-free, fuss-free

Babies rub everything into their eyes. Tear-free formulas keep bath time calm for both of you.

03

Fair price, every month

Baby products are a repeat purchase. Buying direct from the maker means fewer mark-ups on something you will reorder for years.

04

One maker, head to toe

Wash, lotion, wipes and laundry from the same maker, in a single order delivered to your door.

Worth knowing

A day in their skin

Baby skin is thinner than ours and loses moisture faster. Count how many products touch it between waking up and bedtime. Each one is worth a second look.

  • ✓It adds up. Five or more products, every single day, for years.
  • ✓Residue counts too. What is left on clothes and bedding stays on their skin far longer than the bath does.
  • ✓Simple is kind. Short ingredient lists, no added dyes, light or no fragrance.
  1. Wipesat every change
  2. Bath washhead to toe
  3. Lotionafter every bath
  4. Clothesand the detergent left in them
  5. Beddingall night long
